$comment: BC Transit's Fraser Valley feed (Consat operator 13), covering Agassiz-Harrison, Central Fraser Valley, Chilliwack, and Hope; checked 2026-10-28. Every route is drawn. This feed is primary in fraser-valley and an overlay in metro-vancouver where its routes reach Lougheed. Terms: https://www.bctransit.com/open-data/terms-of-use/ (identify BC Transit as the source; no use of its marks).
name: BC Transit (Fraser Valley)

static.$comment: The operator 13 export contains the four systems together. It has a daily feed_version and rolls off past dates; how often service itself changes remains open (config/regions/fraser-valley/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #1).

realtime.$comment: No API key or stated request limit. One request covers the operator 13 systems; polled within a modest budget (config/regions/fraser-valley/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #2).
realtime.$poll: Guess, to be polite to a provider that states no limit: positions every 30 s while buses run (05:00-24:00), every 60 s overnight; trip updates every 2 minutes, 5 overnight; alerts every 5 minutes, 15 overnight. About 3,460 requests a day; dailyCap is a safety net. OPEN-QUESTIONS #2.
realtime.$staleGraceS: Clients fall back to schedule estimates once live data is this much older than the positions poll interval (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$coverageSlackS: Recorder coverage breaks when snapshots are further apart than the positions poll interval plus this (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$interpolateSlackS: Interpolate between two fixes at most the positions poll interval plus this (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$extrapolateSlackS: Predict a bus forward for at most the positions poll interval plus this (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).

display.$tripId: Consat trip ids begin with the journey id, as in BC Transit's other feeds.
display.$feedVersion: Versions begin with an export date and sequence number, before slash-separated export times.
